description: She wears an opaque dark blue floor-length square-neck fitted court dress with gold tablet-woven borders, elbow-length sleeves, shoulder straps secured by round bronze brooches and a woven gold-blue belt. Cream linen shows at the lower skirt and cuffs. A pale grey-brown fringed wool wrap rests along her arms, and brown leather shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons.
